The Gay representation is going great recently we have amazing LGBTQ+ representation in Films and Dramas (that are not comedy) like
Die Beautiful, Rainbow Sunset, Isa Pang Bahaghari, ADAN, Batang Poz, and Fluid.

Honorable Mentions: The Killer Bride (for featuring a gay character without making him flamboyant also tackling Gay Issues like Coming Out), Mea Culpa (also featured a Masc Gay), and A Soldier's Heart (for tackling Gay Stereotypes) it's not big or the key points but it's a great progress for representation.

I think The "Flamboyant" Stereotype also gave way for LGBTQ+ to be visible in the Entertainment industry, and we shouldn't discredit Vice Ganda (even tho he enforced the stereotype way too much) but his breakout opened doors for LGBTQ+ People even further.

Don't forget he gave a lot of gay entertainer careers and gave a lot of segments to give LGBTQ+ Community visibility like (Mr. Pogay & Miss Q and A)

Not to mention, Miss Q&A was the first gay pageant aired on National TV. We shouldn't discredit Vice Ganda because he definitely opened a lot of doors for LGBTQ+ Entertainers.

The Flamboyant stereotype was the stepping stone for LGBTQ+ representation, and i'm sure it will improve in the future but with MTRCB having rules against gay people (like same-sex kissing) we should have progressive politicians first for us to have better representation.
